scoring.range: Each dimension is an integer from 0 to 5. Score is positive sum minus negative sum.

opportunities.observed_pain: Provider cost is discussed, but cost per accepted repository decision has not been measured on a fixed corpus.
opportunities.hypothesis: A Jev gate cuts downstream expensive-provider input by at least 50% with unchanged acceptance criteria and zero false supported decisions.
opportunities.baseline: Run the same fixed downstream model on all 12 labeled cases.
opportunities.success_metric: At least 50% lower downstream input cost per accepted result, zero false supports, and no material calibration regression.
opportunities.falsifier: Any false support, lower acceptance quality, or human-review and retry cost that erases the saving.
opportunities.simpler_alternative: Deterministic rules or repository search before any model call.
opportunities.authority: Human approves live spend and any integration; model output never grants effects.
opportunities.next_gate: Run the bounded 13-call calibration, then a fixed downstream A/B only if quality passes.
opportunities.result: Offline plan: 12 cases, 13 calls, zero retries, $0.0021 hard ceiling. No live Jev result yet.

opportunities.observed_pain: Course prose, runnable examples, three locale mirrors and journals can drift because their relationship is mostly checked manually.
opportunities.hypothesis: A machine-readable opportunity registry plus executable journal checks reduces drift and unsupported claims without making authoring slower.
opportunities.baseline: Current manual review of prose, code, journal evidence and EN/FR/ES mirrors.
opportunities.success_metric: Zero matrix drift, every measured claim linked to an artifact, locale file parity, and authoring lead time no worse than baseline.
opportunities.falsifier: Generated structure becomes busywork, misses semantic translation drift, or increases lead time without finding defects.
opportunities.simpler_alternative: A small publication checklist enforced in PR review.
opportunities.authority: Course author records evidence; reviewer accepts or rejects publication claims.
opportunities.next_gate: Use this course to validate its own registry, generated matrices and locale parity in CI.
opportunities.result: Registry, renderer and invariant tests implemented as the first tracer bullet.

opportunities.observed_pain: Infrastructure coupling is suspected at some orchestration boundaries, but no current cross-repository inventory is attached.
opportunities.hypothesis: One evidence-backed port around a frequently changed external dependency reduces test setup and change surface.
opportunities.baseline: Measure callers, dependency fan-in, test setup and files changed for one real boundary before refactoring.
opportunities.success_metric: Smaller change surface and simpler deterministic tests on the selected seam, with no extra pass-through abstraction.
opportunities.falsifier: The port only renames an existing interface or increases indirection without reducing coupled changes.
opportunities.simpler_alternative: Keep the current interface and add one focused contract test.
opportunities.authority: Repository maintainer selects the seam after reviewing evidence.
opportunities.next_gate: Choose one exact dependency boundary and capture a before metric; otherwise reject the candidate.

opportunities.technique: RabbitMQ quorum, retry and dead-letter boundary
opportunities.observed_pain: Cross-process reliability is important, but no evidence yet shows RabbitMQ is simpler than the existing artifact and GitHub contracts.
opportunities.hypothesis: A bounded broker tracer improves recoverable delivery for one high-contention path without replacing durable repository artifacts.
opportunities.baseline: Measure loss, duplicate handling and recovery time in the current path.
opportunities.success_metric: Demonstrably better recovery with idempotent consumers and lower operational cost than the current mechanism.
opportunities.falsifier: The broker duplicates existing durable contracts or adds an always-on dependency without a measured reliability gain.
opportunities.simpler_alternative: Keep append-only artifacts and improve reconciliation.
opportunities.authority: Architecture owner approves any infrastructure addition.
opportunities.next_gate: Identify one failure mode that existing artifact reconciliation cannot solve economically.
opportunities.result: Local course examples exist; no repository adoption evidence.
